ChatGPT Edu is listed for University of Pisa in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

The University of Pisa IT system supports centralized acquisition of ChatGPT Education for teachers and researchers who want to use generative AI tools in academic contexts, with an advanced service level and stronger confidentiality guarantees.

The University of Pisa IT system has activated a centralized purchase procedure for Microsoft Copilot 365 licenses on personal research funds, with interested teachers and researchers directed to signal interest through their structural RED.
University of Pisa describes Sibylla as an open-source AI chat system developed by the university that can provide information in any language about university regulations and operations.

University of Pisa's official IT-services AI hub lists AI software and utilities based on generative artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT Education and Copilot 365, as tools to support teaching, research, and productivity.
